The '''Shorwilts''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Tor Bez'lin]] was a member of this species.

==Biology and appearance==
Shorwilts<ref name="TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> were a large [[humanoid]] [[species]] distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] and tan textured skin, wide features, blubbery necks, large mouths, and wide-set eyes and nostrils. They had distinct prehensile tentacles that were normally attached to their backs and the tops of their heads, blending in with the rest of their skin, though they could peel back, detach, and extend them, able to grab and constrain things with the appendage's slimy, spiky surface.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Shorwilts in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Tor Bez'lin]],<ref name="TVG" /> had been arrested and detained by the [[Galactic Republic]]. Bez'lin briefly escaped custody alongside other inmates, but was re-arrested by the [[Jedi Order]] shortly thereafter.<ref name="Episode I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the [[2024]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="Episode I" />
